title: A Phorepoc listing: one installable item and the releases this index approves

id.description: Unique id, the listing folder's name: lower case, digits, '-' and '.'

group.description: The app this listing is a build of: listings of one app for different architectures share it (default: the id). The website shows one card per group; the phone, which installs one architecture, ignores it

name.description: The app's name, the same for every architecture (no "(PC)" or "(phones)")

asset.description: Regular expression the installable asset's file name must match (default: \.sisx?$)

text.description: The folder in the repo holding the store text, summary.txt (one line) and description.md (Markdown), written by the item's authors (default: catalogue)

releases.description: The releases this index approves: explicit tags, or "latest" for the newest non-prerelease

boards.description: Absent = any board of the architecture

min_core.description: Oldest core the item runs on: that core commit's UTC committer time, YYYY.MM.DD.HHMMSS (images state theirs as core= in device.txt)

legacy.description: Runs on stock Symbian OS 9.x phones too (not only Phorepoc)

needs_platsec_hack.description: Installs only on a phone whose platform security is patched

featured.description: Shown in the home page's Featured carousel (set by a maintainer; one listing of the group is enough)

requires.description: Ids of other listings that must be installed first

tags.description: What the item is, for Catalogue's Categories filters: one to five words from this fixed vocabulary (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

icon.description: File in the listing folder (PNG, square, >= 128 px; the SVG source may sit next to it as icon.svg)

icon_credit.description: Whose the icon is and under which terms, when it is a project's own logo (one line; LOGOS.md has the sources)
